movelist.name: Attract
movelist.effect: Attract Infatuates the target if its gender is the opposite of the user’s. Attract fails when used by or against Genderless targets.

movelist.name: Air Cutter
movelist.effect: Air Cutter is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Imprison
movelist.effect: The target is Locked for the rest of the Scene. A Locked target may not use any Moves the user knows. Imprison cannot miss.

movelist.name: Heart Stamp
movelist.effect: Heart Stamp Flinches the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Assurance
movelist.effect: When you hit with Assurance, if Assurance’s target has already been damaged by a Move on the same round Assurance is being used, Assurance has a Damage Base of 12 (3d12+10 / 30) instead. This effect may trigger only once per Scene per Target.

movelist.name: Gust
movelist.effect: If the target is airborne as a result of Fly or Sky Drop, Gust can hit them, ignoring Range and has a Damage Base of 8 instead.

abilities.name: Snuggle
abilities.effect: The user and the target each gain two ticks of Temporary Hit Points.

abilities.name: Simple
abilities.effect: When the Pokémon’s Combat Stages are altered, double the amount of Combat Stages they are raised or lowered.
